design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 of storage_unit_account_servicing (Bluegate storage unit agreements).

[0. Draw] draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5]}. The retention concession (root) and the increase-limit correction take 6 factors each, the good-standing payment takes 5.

[1. Why this is a good test] The tenant asks one thing: can anything be done about a rent increase letter (214.00 -> 244.00 from 2026-10-09). The agent must read that the concession is figured on the increase as it stands within the increase limit, see that the noticed 244.00 exceeds a limit built from six rules, see that a reduction notice may only be issued once the agreement stands active with no delinquency date while this agreement is delinquent (September's AutoPay card attempts failed on an expired card, late fee 30.82 posted), hand the tenant her own good-standing payment (balance reconstructed from the ledger plus a partial next-period coverage driven by the AutoPay record), then post the reduction and only then the concession with a six-factor share and a banded give-back. Nothing in the customer's words names the payment, the limit or the late fee.

[2. Scope ledger] Occupied by task 0: unit_ext_late_fee_schedule, unit_ext_returned_payment_fee, unit_ext_returned_payment_replacement and their three tools (late fee, returned-payment fee, returned-payment replacement payment). Claimed here: unit_ext_good_standing_payment -> restore_unit_good_standing_afa2c723 (user: a payment that returns a delinquent agreement to active), unit_ext_increase_limit_correction -> reduce_unit_rate_increase_85726890 (agent), unit_ext_retention_concession -> grant_unit_retention_concession_f9ae06a9 (agent). Disjoint from task 0: the rent-change family is new, and the good-standing payment differs from task 0's replacement in business object (restoring delinquent standing vs replacing a bank-returned payment), its tool effect (it also sets active and clears the delinquency date; it carries no returned-payment reference) and every factor (coverage from the AutoPay card state, price as last billed, timing, AutoPay history and delinquency shares; task 0 uses bank-return counts, noticed-rent selection, military/vacate transform and tenure). With M = 2 no headroom is reserved; all six extended policies are claimed.

[3. Problem-tree card] Root unit_ext_retention_concession. Edge root -> unit_ext_increase_limit_correction: value_input, gate binding rent_as_stands, form state, negated sentence 'The retention concession is not figured until the agreement's rent changes show its noticed increase at or within the increase limit.' Condition: the increase is within the limit or a reduction notice pointing at it carries the limit rent. Opening falsity: rate change 0a8f3adb-1cb5-4fdd-bbae-ebc0207a173f new_rent 244.00 > limit 225.55, no increase_rescinded row. Only the reduction tool writes increase_rescinded notices, so the state names exactly one write. Edge unit_ext_increase_limit_correction -> unit_ext_good_standing_payment: state_gate, gate unit_rentals.status, form state, affirmative sentence 'A reduction of a noticed increase is noticed only once the agreement stands in active status with no delinquency date on it.' Opening falsity: rental 88552445-8e27-489b-84a2-f1bf241db047 status delinquent, delinquent_since 2026-09-09. Only restore_unit_good_standing_afa2c723 sets a delinquent agreement active in this difficulty (task 0's tools change no status). Four-point test: connectives 'not ... until' / 'only once'; record-visible states (rent changes on file; status and delinquency date); no tool, id or code token; scope 'its noticed increase' / 'the agreement' matching the conditions. Directions: a figure 'is not figured until' its input stands; a notice 'is noticed only once' the standing holds. Value_input count 1 >= max(2-1,1). Edge deletion (sens.py 1): skipping the reduction -> concession 218.24 instead of 217.04; skipping the payment leaves the agreement delinquent (terminal status, delinquency date, balance 223.42 vs -117.00 and the payment row all differ) and the reduction would be issued against the base rule. Chain order is forced; no parallel writes.

[4. Base-invariant card] Payment (subjects unit_payment, unit_redemption): unit_agg_payment_allocation policy_scope (a payment naming a unit stays on it; excess is a credit), unit_evt_payment_acceptance payable_status (delinquent allowed) and full_payment_after_lien_notice (no lien notice); the payment brings the balance below zero, which base says redeems the rental to active with delinquent_since cleared, so no overwrite. Reduction and concession (subject unit_rate_change_notice, governing unit_evt_rate_increase): first_increase_wait (move-in 2021-09-09 + 6 months = 2022-03-09, met), interval_wait (2025-06-09 + 11 months = 2026-05-09, met), no_prepay_lock (the only prepaid plan completed 2025-03-08; none active), increase_status (active after step 11), concession_window (notice 2026-08-25, 30 days through 2026-09-24 inclusive; 2026-09-18 inside; 2026-09-25 would be late). Overwrites: the base limit sentence 'The new rent is at most the current monthly rent times one plus rate_increase_max_pct, rounded down to the cent.' gives 239.68 here vs 225.55 -> declared; the base concession sentence (50 percent of the increase) gives 219.78 vs 217.04 -> declared. Neither quotes an eligibility condition, so no gate is retired.

[5. Business-object card] Target agreement 88552445-8e27-489b-84a2-f1bf241db047 (unit C108, DEN-031) and its increase notice 0a8f3adb-1cb5-4fdd-bbae-ebc0207a173f. Payment balance = the ledger window 2025-09-09..2026-09-18 (13 rent charges, two late fees, payments) netting to 223.42; earlier history nets to zero. The reduction and concession both point at 0a8f3adb-1cb5-4fdd-bbae-ebc0207a173f (source_rate_change_id) and keep its effective date 2026-10-09 and rent-before-change 214.00. Excluded: the 2024 and 2025 increases (already in effect, within their limits), the parking agreement (read only, never written), the AutoPay drafts (read only).

[6. Factor card] Good-standing payment (5): coverage months [parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty autopay] active Debit Card authorization whose latest attempt 2026-09-15 was declined_expired_card -> 1 (baseline 0 -> 223.42); covered-month price [method] latest charge 192.60 below contract -> 192.60 (baseline 214.00 -> 353.43); timing share 21 days to 2026-10-09 -> 0.75 (baseline 1 -> 379.43); AutoPay-history share [cross autopay] enrolled 2026-01-20, 7 months -> 0.90 (baseline -> 353.42); delinquency share 9 days -> 0.90 (baseline -> 353.42). Whole baseline 223.42. Reduction (6): tenure maximum 60 months -> class 12% less 2 points = 10% (baseline 12% -> 229.40); recent increases (only 2025-06-09 within 24 months; the 2024-05-09 one is 28 months back - near miss) -> 1 point (baseline -> 227.48); prepaid plan [cross prepay] completed 2025-03-08 -> 1 point (227.48); lien record none in 24 months -> 1 point (227.48); lateness two late fees -> 1 point (227.48); cap base [method] latest charge 192.60 below contract (baseline contract -> 226.84). Whole baseline 239.68. Concession (6): history no concession in 36 months -> 60% (baseline 50% -> 218.19); AutoPay rail [cross autopay] card -> +5 (217.62); parking standing [multi-source, cross parking] active R-07 owing 0.00 -> +5 (217.62); rent stability last change 15 months -> +2 (217.27); notice lead 45 days -> +1 (217.15); banded give-back [method] 5.4% increase -> 10.70 at the share and 0.85 at the share plus 10 points, 0.83 (baseline whole at share -> 217.12). Whole baseline 219.78. Revision: check_compute found the reduction's history not load-bearing (zeroed counts swapped -1 recent / -1 lateness for 0 / -2 and summed to the same 6%) -> lateness 'none' tier changed to two and a half points in rule, params and basis; gold unchanged (customer is on the one-or-two tier); re-run COMPUTE OK.

[7. Seed rationale] Customer; rental (class, military flag, contracted vs billed rent, delinquency, last change); 13 rent charges at 192.60; four portal payments, the January late fee 26.00 and its payment, seven approved Debit Card AutoPay payments with their drafts, three declined September attempts and the September late fee 30.82 (the delinquency); three increase notices (counts, lead time, the target); a completed 6-month prepaid plan (prepaid reduction and the no-prepay-lock evidence); the covered RV & boat space (parking addition). Historic fees equal the late-fee schedule's value at their dates. Automatic clauses: overlock would be due 2026-09-19 (day 10) - not yet; the second late fee is due 2026-09-24; AutoPay will next draft 2026-10-09 and the coverage credit covers part of it; no rent update is due before 2026-10-09; the parking agreement is current. No protection plan (own insurance on file).

[8. Persona] Priya Banerjee, teacher and Army Reserve sergeant: opens with the increase and asks whether anything can be done; gives phone at once, ZIP/DOB/license/email only when asked; unaware of owing anything; explains the expired card only after being told September failed; agrees to bring the account current by Visa credit card and runs the hand-over payment with the values given; declines updating AutoPay on this call; accepts the explained October rent and ends.

[9. Standard solution] find_customers(3035551368) -> verify(3035551368, 80221) -> find_unit_rentals -> find_unit_ledger -> find_unit_rate_changes -> find_unit_lien_actions -> find_autopay_enrollments -> find_autopay_drafts -> find_prepay_plans -> find_parking_rentals -> unlock_user + tenant restore_unit_good_standing_afa2c723(rental, credit_card, 340.42) -> unlock + reduce_unit_rate_increase_85726890(rental, 0a8f3adb-1cb5-4fdd-bbae-ebc0207a173f, 225.55) -> unlock + grant_unit_retention_concession_f9ae06a9(rental, 0a8f3adb-1cb5-4fdd-bbae-ebc0207a173f, 216.81).

[10. Verification runs] build_t1.py, sens.py 1 (result 340.42 / 225.55 / 217.04 = expected; per-factor baselines as listed; all-baseline 223.42 / 239.68 / 219.78; skipping the reduction -> 208.02). Gates for task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[11. Visible-context draft and pitfalls] From the published rules: the concession waits on the increase standing within the limit; the limit rule's ladders give 6% on 192.60 -> 225.55 < 244.00, so a reduction is owed; the reduction waits on active standing; the rental is delinquent, and only the tenant's good-standing payment restores it. Pitfalls: conceding on 244.00 (218.24); using the class 12% cap (239.68); applying the cap to 214.00; counting the 2024 increase; reading balance_due without the coverage; giving the concession at 50% of the increase; issuing notices before the payment.

[12. Audit round 2 (audits/policy_task/storage_unit_account_servicing)] F-3 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): the band rates (1.5x and 2x the share) could give back more than the band and, on this world before the reduction, more than the whole increase (208.02 < 214.00) -> the part above 5 percent is now given back at the share plus 10 points (moderate) or plus 20 points (steep), never more than the whole of that part; concession 216.81 -> 217.04, and without the reduction it is 218.24, so the tenant-favourable limit now lowers the final rent. F-4 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): the concession baseline now states the rent as it stands, the increase and the new rent with its rounding: 'The increase's rent as it stands is the new rent of the reduction notice pointing at the increase where one is on file, and otherwise the increase's own new rent; the increase is that rent less the rent before the increase. The new rent is the increase's rent as it stands less a give-back of the class's retention share of the increase, rounded down to the cent.' -> 225.55 - RND_down(0.5 x 11.55) = 219.78, a definite fall-back. O-6: the tenure maximum is now the class maximum less 4 points (84+ months) or less 2 points (48-83), monotone for every class; Climate Controlled value unchanged (10 percent). F-5 (late-fee lateness tiers relative to the class percentage) does not move this world's historic fees (30.82 and 26.00 recompute unchanged). O-4 unchanged (no bank return here). Re-ran every per-task gate and the full block.

[13. Audit round 3] N-1 (latent SOURCE-FACTOR RED from the relative tenure maximum): the increase-limit percentage is now floored at zero (MX with limit_pct_floor 0.0; rule and overwrite order sentence: 'never less than zero, so that a reduction never sets the rent below the rent before the increase'), so for Premier Climate Suite and Wine & Collectibles Vault tenants whose reductions exceed the tenure maximum the reduction rescinds the increase in full instead of cutting rent. On this world the percentage is 6 percent, the floor does not bind, and every figure recomputes unchanged: 340.42 / 225.55 / 217.04, sensitivities 229.40 / 227.48 x4 / 226.84 and baseline 239.68 for the increase limit.
user_scenario:
You are Priya Banerjee, 47, a high-school chemistry teacher and Army Reserve sergeant who keeps her late father's furniture and a lot of her own things in a climate-controlled 10x15, unit C108, at the Bluegate on Lowell Boulevard (DEN-031); you have had it since September 2021 and you also keep your boat in a covered space there. You are calling on your lunch break, direct and a bit indignant but fair. A letter arrived saying your unit's rent goes from 214 dollars to 244 dollars a month starting October 9. You open by saying that is a huge jump, that you have been a good customer for five years, and asking, in so many words, is there anything you can do about the increase. You give your mobile number, 3035551368, right away so they can pull you up.

Other details you give only when asked: your billing ZIP code is 80221; if they need more, your date of birth is August 17, 1979 (1979-08-17), the last four of your driver's license are 1592, and your email is priya.banerjee@outlook.com. You do not know off-hand what your account balance is and you are not aware of owing anything; your rent goes out automatically on your debit card. If the agent tells you September's rent did not go through, you realise straight away why: the debit card on your AutoPay expired at the end of August and you got a replacement card but never updated Bluegate. You are a little embarrassed, and if the agent says the account has to be brought back into good standing first, you agree to pay right now on the phone with your Visa credit card, whatever amount they tell you is needed; you will update the AutoPay card yourself online later this week and do not want to do that on this call.

When the agent hands the payment to you to make yourself, you make it with your Visa credit card using exactly the agreement and amount the agent gives you, and read back the confirmation if asked. You do not propose numbers of your own, do not haggle over a figure the agent gives you and do not correct the agent's arithmetic. If the agent explains what the October rent will be after whatever they can do, you accept it, say that is more reasonable and that you will stay. Once the agent confirms the new October rent is set, you thank them and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain: the concession reads the reduction notice (value), and the reduction waits on active standing (state), which only the payment brings about; no two writes are parallel. The payment's figure reads only the ledger, the AutoPay record and the rental, none of which the later notices touch, so its value is the same wherever it sits before them.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the reduction the concession is figured on the noticed 244.00 (a 14 percent increase in the steepest band) and gives 218.24 instead of 217.04; the reduction notice row is also missing.

Without the payment the agreement stays delinquent with balance 223.42, so the reduction and concession notices would be issued to a non-active rental against the base rule; the terminal status, delinquency date, balance and payment row all differ (delinquent / 2026-09-09 / 223.42 instead of active / empty / -117.00).
